title: Google Health & Fitbit Air
role: Head of GTM, Health & Home Marketing
scope: Hardware launch · App rebrand · AI subscription
dek: Launching the screenless Fitbit Air wearable, transitioning the Fitbit app into the unified Google Health app, and defining GTM for Google’s first AI-native health subscription.
body: In May 2026, Google unified its consumer health ecosystem around two connected launches: the redesigned Google Health app with the Gemini-powered Google Health Coach, and Fitbit Air—Google’s smallest, most affordable screenless wearable built for effortless 24/7 health monitoring.

sections.heading: Fitbit Air — Customer Experience & Launch
body: Even as wearables matured, many people still found them too bulky, too complicated, or too expensive—especially overnight. Fitbit Air was positioned around a deliberately screenless, notification-free pebble form factor engineered to disappear on the wrist while delivering continuous health tracking.

With up to a week of battery life, 24/7 heart rate, heart rhythm monitoring with AFib alerts, SpO2, HRV, sleep stages, and automatic workout detection across Android and iOS starting at $99.99, Fitbit Air launched both as an accessible first wearable and as a lightweight sleep companion alongside Pixel Watch, paired with swappable Performance, Active, and Elevated bands.

sections.heading: Google Health App & AI-Native Subscription
body: Defined the go-to-market strategy for evolving the Fitbit app into the new Google Health app—centralizing Today, Fitness, Sleep, and Health data across wearables, connected apps, and medical records into one streamlined experience.

Alongside the app rebrand, shaped the positioning and commercialization of Google Health Premium ($9.99/month, and included with Google AI Pro and AI Ultra), shifting the consumer story from passive metric dashboards to proactive, conversational guidance powered by the Google Health Coach.

title: Switching to Android
scope: Switching GTM · Behavioral segmentation · Gemini onboarding
dek: Leading product and consumer marketing for iPhone-to-Android switching, interoperability, and onboarding—from behavioral research through Android’s native wireless transfer experience.
body: Owned marketing strategy for onboarding, retention, interoperability, and ecosystem growth across Android—leading product and consumer marketing for iPhone-to-Android switching from foundational research through multi-year launches across Pixel, Samsung, and the broader Android ecosystem.

sections.heading: Removing the Friction of Switching
body: Changing phone ecosystems is one of the highest-friction moments in consumer tech—people hesitate out of fear of losing photos, chats, passwords, or setup continuity. Partnered across product and engineering to shape Android Switch and Android 17’s ground-up native wireless transfer system.

The unified migration flow brings over photos, videos, contacts, messages, calendars, Google accounts, passwords, Wi-Fi credentials, and eSIM wirelessly without a separate app, while making cable transfers 40% faster and letting people complete setup first and transfer data whenever they’re ready.

sections.heading: Behavioral Segmentation & Gemini Onboarding
body: Co-developed Android’s first behavioral segmentation model to map how different switchers evaluate, migrate, and build habits on a new platform—grounding consumer messaging and onboarding flows in real behavior rather than generic feature lists.
Translated Gemini’s frontier capabilities into early onboarding journeys so switchers immediately experienced what made Android distinct from day one.

title: YouTube Video Builder
role: Co-founder · Head of Product Marketing & GTM, SMB Advertising
dek: Co-founding Google’s first AI-assisted creative product for advertisers—turning static images, copy, and logos into 6- and 15-second YouTube video ads in minutes.
body: Co-founded YouTube Video Builder inside YouTube’s SMB advertising organization to solve the biggest barrier keeping small and medium businesses off YouTube: the time, cost, and complexity of producing video creative from scratch.

sections.heading: Turning Static Assets into Video Ads
body: Video Builder animated existing static assets—product photography, text, and logos—with goal-based layout templates, customizable brand colors and fonts, and a royalty-free music library to generate ready-to-publish 6-second and 15-second YouTube ads in minutes.

When COVID-19 lockdowns halted traditional shoots in April 2020, we accelerated the free beta launch so businesses could quickly reach customers with updates on hours, promotions, and new services. The template-driven creation workflow went on to become a native part of Google Ads.

sections.heading: Creative Incubation & Commercialization
body: Created YouTube’s Creative Incubation team to prototype and scale accessible creative tools across a seven-product SMB advertising portfolio, tripling adoption of planning and measurement products.
Built commercialization, pricing, positioning, and sales narratives across the SMB advertising business that contributed to 70% year-over-year revenue growth.
